Aug 2026 • Family

Excellent steak dinner in Hanoi
Jan 2026 • Solo
Staying at The Lapis Hotel, and not wanting to travel far, ventured across the street to SteakOut for dinner - warm and welcoming - gentle background music and a great vibe - very helpful staff who could speak excellent English - delicious warm bread rolls with truffle butter and pate - a fruity mocktail, NZ tenderloin steak with fries and truffle mushroom sauce - cooked perfectly to my specifications - lemon tart and Vietnamese coffee to finish - a very reasonably priced, delicious dinner in a nice atmosphere with friendly and professional staff. Highly recommend!

Dec 2025 • Family

Kindness, taste and efficiency all at once
Dec 2025 • Couples
We have just had dinner at this beautiful and cozy restaurant. To tell the truth we are delighted to have chosen this restaurant which was just in front of our hotel. Efficiency, kindness, and a tasty food all at once. The best restaurant we have tried so far in Hanoi. I must thank Mr Trung, the restaurant supervisor who has been extremely helpful and have a wonderful team with him. I particularly had a beef tenderloin and the meat was fabulous. I had to wave this out to inmortalizar this restaurant in trip advisor.
Thank you very much Mr Trying. I very much appreciated all your efforts to make us have this beautiful and enjoyable evening.
